mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, USER_PASS, ROLE, USER_NAME, USER_BIR, USER_EMAIL, USER_TEL, USER_ADDR1, USER_ADDR2, USER_ZIP ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPass}, 'USER', #{userName}, CASE WHEN #{userBir} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{userBir}) = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{userBir}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, #{userEmail}, #{userTel}, #{userAddr1}, #{userAddr2}, #{userZip} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_PASS, ROLE, USER_NAME, USER_BIR, USER_EMAIL, USER_TEL, USER_ADDR1, USER_ADDR2, USER_ZIP FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET ROLE = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE USER_ID = #{value} AND UPPER(ROLE) != 'ADMIN' AND UPPER(ROLE) != 'WITHDRAWN'
